'''''Fetch''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. '''Fetch''' was stationed on the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Link]]'' that was attempting to warn the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] stationed on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] that the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was fully operational and the Rebels were heading into a [[Battle of Endor/Legends|trap]]. However, the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] had overloaded and the ship was stranded. '''Fetch''' was then dispatched to deliver [[Fuel Rod]]s from [[Class-C cargo container]] ''[[Rubol]]'' when it was intercepted and destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
